subject.title: Enhancement: Developer experience quick wins from code analysis

question: Should model-routed skill-command prompt rewriting be surfaced by default, only through debug/trace diagnostics, or not added because the documented default is sufficient?
rationale: The remaining request changes operator-facing observability rather than repairing a broken documented contract, so maintainers must choose the useful audience and acceptable noise level.

options.title: Add debug/trace diagnostics
options.body: Emit a structured debug or trace event that identifies the model-routed skill-command branch without adding default user-facing noise.

options.title: Add a default warning
options.body: Log a concise warning on every model-routed skill invocation so operators can see the routing decision without enabling diagnostics.

options.title: Keep the documented behavior
options.body: Do not add a new signal because the current slash-command documentation already distinguishes model-directed and deterministic tool dispatch.

recommendation.title: Add debug/trace diagnostics
recommendation.body: Emit a structured debug or trace event that identifies the model-routed skill-command branch without adding default user-facing noise.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied prior review and feature-history context make this the strongest available routing candidate for the remaining product choice.
